title: Booked at 10, leaving at 0
hook: The calendar shows the meeting slot free.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: Reserve travel as a separate time block.

objective: Reserve travel as a separate time block.

claims.text: Scenario and prediction: The calendar shows the meeting slot free. You leave at 0 and travel 15 minutes. The meeting is booked for 10. How do you arrive? Correct option: Late by 5 min. All fixture labels and durations are stipulated exercise data.

claims.text: Travel time occupies a block just as the meeting does. In this fixture, an overlap means the same person is booked twice.
claims.source: Explicit exercise fixture in src/lib/lifehacks/studyCatalog.ts and pure rules in studyModels.ts. All times, sizes, deadlines and outcomes describe this exercise only; no empirical productivity or learning effect is inferred. recall.question: Your calendar is free 10:00–10:30, then a 10:30 meeting 25 minutes away (no delays). How much of that slot is really free?
recall.why: The 25-minute trip occupies 10:05–10:30, so only five minutes remain before you leave.
